name: The Lodge & Spa at Brush Creek Ranch
positioning: All-inclusive Western guest ranch with log cabins and a spa, on a working cattle ranch in Wyoming's North Platte River Valley
best_for: Families who want guided outdoor activities such as horseback riding, hiking and fly-fishing
Travelers looking for a remote, all-inclusive ranch stay with a spa

facts.text: The Lodge & Spa is set between the Sierra Madre mountain range and Medicine Bow National Forest, minutes from the town of Saratoga.
Brush Creek Ranch is a working cattle ranch on 30,000 acres of sagebrush prairie and rolling hills in Wyoming's North Platte River Valley.
The ranch is surrounded by more than 2 million acres of Medicine Bow-Routt National Forest.
The Lodge & Spa is the original destination within the Brush Creek Luxury Ranch Collection.
The western-style accommodations pay homage to the design and architecture of the original homestead, built in 1884.
Private luxury log cabins range from one to four bedrooms.
Accommodations feature touches like stone fireplaces, cowhide chairs, fur throws, antler chandeliers and vaulted timber ceilings.
The Trailhead Spa offers massages and facials, and has a sauna and steam room.
Yoga and fitness classes take place in settings including a historic schoolhouse and the wellness center.
Stays include three gourmet dining experiences a day and access to select beer, wine and spirits.
The Cheyenne Club serves fine-dining, pasture-to-plate cuisine sourced from the ranch, including ranch-raised Wagyu beef.

highlights.text: Twice-daily guided activities include hiking, mountain biking, ATVing, horseback riding, rock climbing and fly-fishing.
Guestroom windows can look out on grazing horses, deer and pronghorns.
In winter, Brush Creek Ranch has a private ski resort.
The Trailhead Spa's High Plains Detox Facial uses raw cacao, activated bamboo charcoal and prairie herbs.
A 'lil wranglers' program lets kids hang out with guides while parents enjoy some time alone.

considerations.text: The ranch is remote: guests can fly by private air into Saratoga Jet Center, 16 miles from the front gates, or drive approximately one hour from Laramie Regional Airport or three and a half hours from Denver International Airport.
The Lodge & Spa is primarily a screen-free environment, with only a handful of TVs in some common areas.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the premium all-inclusive experience.
